title: Gulch Nashville Home W Rooftop City Views Broadway
description:
Welcome to your modern Nashville retreat in the heart of The Gulch, Nashville, Tennessee, just minutes from Downtown, Broadway, Music Row, and 12 South. This stylish 4-bedroom, 4-bath home is designed for groups, families, and business travelers who want space, comfort, and a true city experience. Enjoy open-concept living, a fully equipped gourmet kitchen, and a rare 900+ sq ft rooftop deck with sweeping Nashville skyline views. Perfect for relaxing or entertaining after a day in the city.

The space
Welcome to this spacious four-bedroom, four-bath home near The Gulch, designed for up to eight guests.

Sleeping layout・4 Bedroom, Sleeps 8
・Bedroom 1: one king bed
・Bedrooms 2–4: one double bed in each room

Enter through the private rear-alley entrance into the two-car garage; the driveway also has room for one vehicle. Please keep the driveway and alley access clear, and note that there is no street parking on 12th Avenue South.

The main living level has hardwood floors, an open kitchen and dining area, and a comfortable living room with a 55-inch TV and gas fireplace. The kitchen includes quartz counters, a gas stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, coffee maker, and a large island. The dining table seats six.

The primary suite includes a king bed, reading area, and private bath with dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. The other three bedrooms each have a double bed, with full bathrooms located throughout the home. An in-unit stackable washer and dryer is located in an upstairs closet.

The 900+ sq. ft. rooftop deck is the highlight, with skyline views, outdoor seating, and space for dining and relaxing.

The home is convenient to The Gulch, Music Row, 12South, Broadway, downtown dining, live music, and Nashville attractions.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
